correctness.rationale: The proof establishes the exact infinite-line single-site survival probability from the Poisson-process Laplace functional; truncation at \(\log^2 n\) has superpolynomially small error, distinct-site joint survival has independent outward-ray bound, and the local-dependence Chen–Stein estimate makes the surviving-site count Poisson at both claimed scales. Union bound gives sharp star-window escape. The first-passage representation equals Markov SI by exponential memorylessness. All 12 deterministic finite Markov CTMC comparisons pass; they are non-proof corroboration. Domain \(n\ge5\), \(\alpha>0\), fixed beta>0 or nonnegative rate sequence with specified limits.

evidence: Bhamidi et al. study weighted typical paths in random configuration-model networks, not hub-rooted flooding over a prescribed wheel (arxiv:0903.5136, Sections 2–3).
Renlund treats asymptotic speed along infinite width-two ladder graphs, not an entire rim with all vertices exposed to a single hub (arxiv:1102.4744, Sections 2–3).

Leskelä and Ngo require a sparse random graph degree family with bounded \(2+\varepsilon\) empirical moments and minimum degree at least 3; the wheel has hub degree n and is deterministic (arxiv:1806.09568, Theorem 2.1).
Published clique-bouquet flooding findings have edge-disjoint petals, whereas the wheel has a single cyclic peripheral link structure.

The ladder and clique-bouquet models do not contain the wheel as a specialization. A general Poisson-approximation theorem is a proof ingredient, not a statement covering these indicators without local estimates.

value.rationale: The result identifies the precise extreme-infection clock of a canonical network formed by adding weak cyclic contacts to a star: fixed positive rim links change the Gumbel rate to \(\alpha+2\beta\) and add a nontrivial shift, while an asymptotically vanishing \(1/\log n\) rim link rate already changes the finite limiting law. This quantifies a physically motivated rare-terminal-isolation mechanism and a sharp finite-size design crossover, not a parameter substitution or small finite table.
